description: Main source file for Bluetooth HCI UART communication in Zephyr OS, handling UART initialization, data reception, packet parsing, and transmission.

methods.name: h4_read
methods.description: Reads data from UART FIFO into buffer.

methods.name: valid_type
methods.description: Checks if packet type is valid (CMD, ACL, ISO).

methods.name: get_len
methods.description: Gets payload length based on packet header and type.

methods.name: hdr_len
methods.description: Returns header length for given packet type.

methods.name: rx_isr
methods.description: UART receive interrupt handler, parses incoming packets.

methods.name: tx_isr
methods.description: UART transmit interrupt handler, sends data from queue.

methods.name: bt_uart_isr
methods.description: UART interrupt callback, dispatches to rx or tx handlers.

methods.name: tx_thread
methods.description: Thread that sends buffers to Bluetooth stack.

methods.name: bt_ctlr_assert_handle
methods.description: Handles critical assertion failures, outputs debug info over UART.

methods.name: hci_uart_init
methods.description: Initializes UART for HCI communication, sets up IRQs.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing Bluetooth UART communication and processing incoming data.
